name: Meal Planning Plugin
description: Recipes, a week's planned meals and the shopping list made from them, in tables of the plugin's own: recipes searched by words, cuisine, tag or ingredient; a week's slots set, not appended to, read day by day; a list whose numeric quantities are summed and whose bought items stay bought when it is made again. The learning path's Extension 4, ported from its standalone MCP server (SMD-2311).
